summary:
TerraPulse is an AI-powered environmental monitoring platform that transforms satellite observations into actionable insights to help communities identify and respond to environmental threats.

Using NASA Earth observation datasets, TerraPulse analyzes environmental indicators such as land surface temperature, vegetation health, precipitation patterns, and changes in land conditions to identify potential drought risks and environmental stress.

The platform presents this information through an interactive geospatial dashboard, allowing users to explore affected regions, monitor environmental changes over time, and better understand emerging risks.

By combining Earth observation, geospatial analytics, and artificial intelligence, TerraPulse aims to make complex satellite data more accessible and useful for researchers, environmental organizations, agricultural stakeholders, and local decision-makers.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between satellite intelligence and real-world environmental action.
details:
Project Overview

TerraPulse is a geospatial environmental intelligence platform designed to transform satellite observations into understandable environmental insights.

The platform focuses on monitoring drought conditions and environmental stress by analyzing multiple Earth observation indicators.

How It Works

The proposed system consists of five main components:

  1. Satellite Data Collection: Retrieves relevant Earth observation datasets from NASA's publicly available data platforms.
  2. Data Processing: Processes geospatial observations and prepares them for regional and temporal analysis.
  3. Environmental Analytics: Examines vegetation conditions, precipitation trends, and land surface temperature.
  4. Risk Assessment: Combines environmental indicators into interpretable risk categories, with transparent thresholds and limitations.
  5. Interactive Dashboard: Displays maps, historical trends, regional comparisons, and environmental insights.

Technology Stack

  • Python for data processing and analytics.
  • FastAPI for backend services.
  • React or Next.js for the frontend.
  • Leaflet or Mapbox for interactive mapping.
  • Google Earth Engine for geospatial analysis.
  • NASA Earthdata APIs for accessing satellite observations.
  • Machine learning tools for experimental environmental pattern analysis.

Innovation

TerraPulse focuses on making satellite data accessible to people who may not have the technical expertise to interpret raw scientific datasets.

Instead of simply displaying satellite imagery, the platform combines different environmental indicators into an understandable monitoring experience.

Expected Impact

TerraPulse aims to support:

  • Agricultural and environmental monitoring.
  • Early identification of potential drought conditions.
  • Environmental research and education.
  • Better-informed regional planning.
  • Greater accessibility to Earth observation information.

The platform is intended as a decision-support and monitoring tool, not a replacement for official meteorological forecasts or emergency warning systems.
